snippet.title: Surf Riders - PS1 (2000)
snippet.description: From developer ACOT. Now this is how you do a surfing game! Challenging but not impossible, with fairly quick recovery time between wipeouts helping to keep frustration down. The water effects are really well-done, and sometimes the feeling of being engulfed by a massive wave is conveyed perfectly.
